    • generateFinalStates

      public ArrayList<State> generateFinalStates(State initialState, Action action)
      Description copied from class: TransitionProbability
      This method constructs an ArrayList<State> of states towards which the stochastic process may transition in period t+1 if action is selected in initialState at period t; note that these states may not yet exist in the state space. This method is used by forward recursion procedures.
      Specified by:
      generateFinalStates in class TransitionProbability
      Parameters:
      initialState - the initial state of the stochastic process; note that we assume that initialState is associated with period t.
      action - the action selected at period t.
      Returns:
      an ArrayList<State> of states towards which the stochastic process may transition in period t+1.

    • getFinalStates

      public ArrayList<State> getFinalStates(State initialState, Action action)
      Description copied from class: TransitionProbability
      This method retrieves an ArrayList<State> of existing states towards which the stochastic process may transition in period t+1 if action is selected in initialState at period t. This method is used by backward recursion procedures.
      Specified by:
      getFinalStates in class TransitionProbability
      Parameters:
      initialState - the initial state of the stochastic process; note that we assume that initialState is associated with period t.
      action - the action selected at period t.
      Returns:
      an ArrayList<State> of states towards which the stochastic process may transition in period t+1.
